description: Import a wiki from a ZIP archive. Agent-friendly: pass zipData (a base64-encoded ZIP, e.g. downloaded from export_wiki's downloadUrl and re-encoded) instead of zipPath for fully agent-reachable round-trips. Supports preview (execute=false) and execute (execute=true). Modes: mode='additive' updates/creates ZIP pages without deleting others; mode='replace' mirrors the ZIP exactly (imports all ZIP pages and deletes pages absent from the ZIP, always overwrite). When execute applies changes, response includes instructionRefreshRequired/discoveredFolders/nextAction hints for instruction refresh.
name: import_wiki
